features.name: Sync your YouTube subscriptions
features.description: TubeScout reads your own subscription list directly from YouTube (read-only) so it tracks exactly the channels you chose — not an algorithmic feed.
features.notes: 816 channels synced via subscriptions.list; OAuth youtube.readonly, nothing posted or changed on YouTube

features.name: Twice-daily upload sweep
features.description: Every channel is checked at 07:00 and 19:00 for new uploads, so you see what's new across all your channels without opening YouTube.
features.notes: Scheduled tasks QI_TubeScout_AM / _PM; 14h overlapping lookback; 4,014 videos discovered to date

features.name: Automatic topic sorting
features.description: Channels are sorted into topics (AI, Software Dev, Travel, Retirement, Science, News, …) so you can read one subject at a time.
features.notes: Keyword profile + YouTube's own topicCategories; cut the 'other' pile from ~450 to ~3

features.name: Quota-safe by design
features.description: Reads uploads from each channel's playlist rather than search, keeping daily API usage far inside YouTube's free tier — no surprises, no cost.
features.notes: 1 unit/channel vs 100 for search; ~600 units/day vs 10,000 free

features.name: Transcript-powered news cards
features.description: Each new video becomes a punchy headline plus a 2–4 sentence brief, written from the actual transcript — read it in seconds instead of watching for minutes.
features.notes: 4,014 summaries stored; 2,374 written by NEXUS, the rest description-fallback

features.name: The news page
features.description: A clean, fast page of media briefs with topic chips, channel labels and a Watch-on-YouTube link — only the videos worth opening.
features.notes: Public HTML page on :8503; NEXUS tangerine theme (#f97316)

features.name: Favorites view
features.description: Star the channels you never want to miss; a dedicated Favorites tab floats their briefs to the top.
features.notes: 66 channels favorited; favorites also get transcript-fetch priority

features.name: "Also covered by N channels"
features.description: When several channels cover the same story, TubeScout shows it once and notes how many others covered it — no repetition.
features.notes: Headline-similarity clustering inside a 72h window; duplicates hidden by default

features.name: Mute the noise, mark must-reads
features.description: Mute channels that clutter the feed or flag must-reads; muted channels stop appearing entirely.
features.notes: Per-channel priority must_read | digest | mute; Disable stops ingestion altogether

features.name: Editable interests
features.description: Tell TubeScout what you care about (AI, Travel, Retirement, DOAC). It steers what gets prioritized and what Discover suggests.
features.notes: Settings → Your interests; comma-separated, applied without restart; default AI/Travel/Retirement/DOAC

features.name: Private channel discovery
features.description: Get suggestions for new channels you'd love — reasoned from your favorites on your own machine, never from your YouTube watch/ad profile.
features.notes: Discover tab; local taste profile + NEXUS reasoning; YouTube touched only for a neutral name lookup

features.name: Follow without subscribing
features.description: Add a suggested channel into TubeScout without ever subscribing on YouTube — keeps your YouTube account untouched.
features.notes: recommend.follow(): ingests the channel + its uploads playlist locally

features.name: Hide whole topics
features.description: Toggle an entire topic (e.g. lifestyle, sports) off the feed in one click.
features.notes: Settings → Topics on the feed; hidden_topics config list

features.name: Implement-worthiness scoring
features.description: AI/dev videos are rated 0–10 on whether they contain something concrete you could actually build or adopt — not just opinion.
features.notes: 439 videos scored via NEXUS; rationale + tags stored per video

features.name: Worth-building items into QI Brain
features.description: Videos scoring above the threshold are logged to the QI Brain as pending-feature candidates for the whole ecosystem.
features.notes: POST /api/log_feature; default threshold 7.0, editable in Settings

features.name: Kaze AI Digest
features.description: The daily AI news digest (by Maia Quiddam, via Kaze) is embedded right in TubeScout and viewable from any computer.
features.notes: Reads C:\APPS\OC\runtime\dashboard\ai-digest\index.html live and re-serves it through TubeScout's own tunnel

features.name: Feeds NEXUS Scout / Kaze
features.description: A curated set of your AI/tech channels is pushed to NEXUS Scout so Kaze's digest automatically picks up YouTube items.
features.notes: OPML of native YouTube RSS feeds → /scout/import/opml; AI/tech topics only, not all 816 subs

features.name: Public news page over a permanent link
features.description: The news page and digest are reachable from anywhere over a stable public URL, with no open ports on the machine.
features.notes: QI_TubeScoutTunnel → tubescout.quiddityinnovations.com (named Cloudflare tunnel)

features.name: Settings as a control panel
features.description: Tune the whole pipeline — interests, thresholds, providers, topic visibility, channel priorities — from one Settings page, no restart.
features.notes: Config-driven; writes back to config/tubescout.json and refreshes the cache

features.name: Write-access protection
features.description: Anyone can read the public page, but changing settings or channels can be locked behind a token for safe public exposure.
features.notes: Central write-guard middleware; open when TUBESCOUT_PAGE_TOKEN unset (local), enforced when set

features.name: Never goes dark
features.description: If transcripts, NEXUS, or the digest source are unavailable, TubeScout falls back gracefully and the page keeps serving.
features.notes: Per-stage try/safe wrappers in the cycle; description-fallback summaries; cached digest

features.name: Polite to YouTube
features.description: The caption fetcher throttles itself and, if YouTube starts blocking, backs off for hours instead of hammering — protecting your access.
features.notes: Randomized throttle + multi-hour IP-block cooldown persisted in the state table

features.name: Local-first transcription (opt-in)
features.description: For videos with no captions, TubeScout can transcribe the audio entirely on your machine — off by default since it downloads audio.
features.notes: faster-whisper + yt-dlp; whisper.enabled flag; live-stream + max-duration guards
